La configuration des équipements est acc: You can configure the devices from the plugin menu (Plugins menu, Connected Devices, then SNMP3).
Le bon fonctionnement du plugin suppose: For the plugin to work properly, the SNMP protocol must be correctly installed and configured on the target system. Refer to the manufacturer's documentation for configuration instructions.
Le bouton **Tester la connexion au SNMP3: The **Test SNMP3 Connection** button lets you test whether the connection settings are correct (be sure to power on the device and save the configuration before clicking the button).
Le plugin permet d'installer des MIBs sp: The plugin allows you to install specific MIBs by placing the corresponding files—for example, SYNOLOGY-SYSTEM-MIB.txt—in the plugins/SNMP3/data/mibs directory.
Le plugin utilise le package php-snmp (v: The plugin uses the php-snmp package (see <https://www.php.net/manual/fr/book.snmp.php>), which is a wrapper for the Net-SNMP library (see <http://www.net-snmp.org>). The plugin allows you to query (get command) and update (set command) OIDs that support it.
Le protocole v3 est conseillé afin de sé: The v3 protocol is recommended to secure the connection.
Lors de l'installation du package php-sn: When you install the php-snmp package, a number of MIBs are installed (usually in the /usr/share/snmp/mibs directory) and can be used immediately.
On peut désigner les OIDs par leur code: OIDs can be identified by their numeric code, for example, .1.3.6.1.4.1.6574.1.1.0, or by using the corresponding MIB, for example, SYNOLOGY-SYSTEM-MIB::systemStatus.0.

Pour les commandes permettant la mise à: For commands that update the OID, the subtype of the action command determines the format of the value transmitted to the SNMP device. When the subtype is 'Message', the header specifies the format and the message body specifies the value (only the first line is transmitted). See <https://www.php.net/manual/fr/function.snmpset.php> for a list of supported formats.

Please note that in this case, the MIBs in the plugins/SNMP3/data/mibs directory are not taken into account.
